subject: Reasons for not fixing pattern coefficients in userGWAS model

messages.author: ba1d5380065b224f
messages.subject: Reasons for not fixing pattern coefficients in userGWAS model
parts:
Hi all,

What are the reasons for not fixing the pattern coefficients estimated in a previous usermodel when later running userGWAS? My thinking was that it otherwise makes sense to fix them. The model fitting runs quicker and the parameter estimates are not varying between variants.

Kind regards,
Johan

messages.author: ac421cf36d1a4c37
messages.subject: Re: Reasons for not fixing pattern coefficients in userGWAS model
parts: They are free parameters that are estimated from the data, so if you fix them, you'd need to do so from the estimates based on the no-SNP model, which is a bit of double dipping. In our experience, it makes very little difference at all.
